import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a bar plot to show the distribution of transaction types, separated by fraud status
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', ax=ax, palette='Set1')

# Add annotations
ax.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Types by Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax.legend(title='Fraud Status', labels=['Not Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
